text: Chhena, drained in muslin, is pressed under a weight to squeeze out more whey, then dipped in chilled water to firm it. Because the casein was set hot by acid, it does not melt when fried or cooked.

steps.note: The curd is pressed under a stone slab; soft paneer is pressed for about 20 min.
The cheese is dipped in chilled water, which firms it.
